overview_description.description:
Campusbees is an early talent management platform offering a comprehensive eco system for college students including - skill evaluation, skill development, campus events, placements, resources and market place. We aim to digitize 300million student profiles by December 2022.
The platform offers latest student management technology to universities and colleges.
